# MSK Institute — Complete Knowledge Base & AI Agent Manifest (Full Context)

## 1. Organization Overview
- **Legal / Brand Name:** MSK Institute (Mastering Software Knowledge)
- **Primary Domain:** https://mskinstitute.in
- **Alternate Domain:** https://www.mskinstitute.in
- **Physical Address:** Gali No. 3, Near Gyan Jyoti Public School, Shikohabad, Uttar Pradesh, 283135, India
- **Primary Contact Number / WhatsApp:** +91 8393042166
- **Email:** mskshikohabad@gmail.com
- **Founder & Head Trainer:** Er. Sumit Kumar (8+ Years Technical & Pedagogical Experience)
- **Type of Institution:** Private Technical Education Academy & Computer Training Institute
- **Focus Areas:** Programming (Python, JavaScript, React, Node.js), Web Development, Database Engineering, NIELIT CCC Government Certification, Office Productivity Suite (MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint), and Practical Software Engineering.

## 2. Institutional Mission & Pedagogy
MSK Institute bridges the gap between traditional academic curriculums and modern software industry expectations for learners in Tier-2/Tier-3 regions of India. Unlike rote-learning centers, MSK Institute emphasizes:
1. **100% Practical Computer Lab Sessions:** Every student writes code, debugs errors, and builds live projects during their class hours.
2. **Project-Driven Assessment:** Courses require capstone project submissions before graduation.
3. **Verifiable Digital Credentials:** Each certificate issued has a unique QR code and ID verifiable on the official portal at `https://mskinstitute.in/verify-certificate`.
4. **Free Open Knowledge:** Over 1,600+ high-quality lessons, cheatsheets, and online tutorials are provided free of cost to self-learners globally.

## 3. Course Catalog & Curriculums

### A. Python Mastery (Beginner to Advanced)
- **URL:** https://www.mskinstitute.in/courses/python-mastery
- **Level:** Beginner to Advanced
- **Duration:** 3 Months (Daily Lab & Theory)
- **Key Modules:**
  - Python Environment Setup & Syntax Basics
  - Control Flow, Conditional Statements, and Loops
  - Functions, Scope, and Modular Programming
  - Data Structures: Lists, Tuples, Dictionaries, Sets
  - Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) in Python
  - File Handling, Exception Management & Debugging
  - Intro to Data Analysis with NumPy & Pandas
  - Capstone Real-World Automation Projects

### B. Full-Stack Web Development
- **URL:** https://mskinstitute.in/courses/full-stack-web-development
- **Level:** Beginner to Professional
- **Duration:** 6 Months
- **Key Modules:**
  - Modern HTML5 Semantic Architecture & Accessibility
  - Advanced CSS3, Flexbox, CSS Grid, Responsive Design & Tailwind CSS
  - JavaScript (ES6+): Closures, Async/Await, Fetch API, DOM Manipulation
  - React.js: Components, State Management, Hooks, Router
  - Node.js & Express.js: REST APIs, Middleware, Authentication
  - Databases: MongoDB & MySQL
  - Deployment, Git, GitHub, and Cloud Hosting

### C. NIELIT CCC (Course on Computer Concepts)
- **URL:** https://mskinstitute.in/courses/nielit-ccc
- **Level:** Beginner (Certification Ready)
- **Duration:** 2 Months
- **Target:** Government Exam Eligibility (UPSSSC, Banking, Railways, State Police)
- **Key Modules:**
  - Introduction to Computers, Hardware & Operating Systems (Windows & Linux)
  - LibreOffice Writer (Word Processing)
  - LibreOffice Calc (Spreadsheets, Formulas & Charts)
  - LibreOffice Impress (Presentations)
  - Internet, WWW, Web Browsers & Cyber Security Essentials
  - Digital Financial Services (UPI, Internet Banking, Aadhaar Enabled Payment)
  - Mock Exam Practice & Question Bank Reviews

### D. JavaScript Mastery (Beginner to Advanced)
- **URL:** https://www.mskinstitute.in/courses/javascript-mastery
- **Level:** Beginner to Advanced
- **Duration:** 3 Months (Daily Practical Lab & Code Reviews)
- **Key Modules:**
  - Modern JavaScript Fundamentals, Syntax, Data Types & Operators
  - DOM Manipulation, Event Listeners, Event Bubbling & Delegation
  - Asynchronous JavaScript: Event Loop, Microtasks, Promises, and async/await
  - Object-Oriented & Functional Programming (Prototypes, ES6 Classes, Closures)
  - Fetch API, RESTful Integration, and Browser Storage (LocalStorage, IndexedDB)
  - Performance Optimization, Memory Management & Chrome DevTools Debugging
  - Capstone Real-World Full-Stack Web Projects

### E. Excel Mastery Course (Beginner to Advanced)
- **URL:** https://www.mskinstitute.in/courses/excel-mastery
- **Level:** Beginner to Advanced
- **Duration:** 6 Months
- **Key Modules:**
  - Complete Spreadsheet Navigation, Formatting & Data Entry
  - Lookup Formulas: XLOOKUP, VLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH & Multi-condition Logic
  - Dynamic Array Formulas: FILTER, UNIQUE, SORT, XMATCH
  - Advanced Pivot Tables, Calculated Fields, Slicers & Timelines
  - Power Query ETL: Data Cleaning, Shape Transformations & Duplicate Elimination
  - Executive Business KPI Dashboards & Foundational Workflow Macros

### F. SQL & MySQL Mastery (Beginner to Advanced)
- **URL:** https://www.mskinstitute.in/courses/sql-mysql-mastery-beginner-to-advanced--3-months
- **Level:** Beginner to Advanced
- **Duration:** 3 Months
- **Key Modules:**
  - Relational Database Design, DDL/DML Commands & Normalization (1NF, 2NF, 3NF)
  - Complex Joins (INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, FULL, Self Joins) & Subqueries
  - Advanced Analytical SQL: Common Table Expressions (CTEs) & Window Functions
  - Stored Procedures, Triggers, Views & Database Transactions (ACID)
  - B-Tree Indexing, EXPLAIN Query Plan Profiling & Performance Tuning

### G. Power BI Mastery (Beginner to Advanced)
- **URL:** https://www.mskinstitute.in/courses/power-bi-mastery-beginner-to-advanced--3-months
- **Level:** Beginner to Advanced
- **Duration:** 3 Months
- **Key Modules:**
  - Power Query ETL & Data Shaping
  - Star Schema Dimensional Modeling & Cardinality
  - DAX Calculations: CALCULATE, Time Intelligence, Filter Context
  - Interactive Visual Reports, Drillthrough Navigation & Tooltips
  - Deployment, Automated Refresh & Row-Level Security (RLS)

### H. Data Analysis Mastery Combo Course
- **URL:** https://www.mskinstitute.in/courses/data-analysis-mastery-combo-course--12-months
- **Level:** Comprehensive / Career Track
- **Duration:** 12 Months
- **Key Modules:**
  - Advanced Excel Modeling & Dashboards
  - SQL Database Engineering & Analytics Queries
  - Python Programming with NumPy & Pandas Data Wrangling
  - Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) & Data Visualization (Matplotlib, Seaborn)
  - Power BI & Tableau Business Intelligence Dashboards
  - Machine Learning Fundamentals for Analysts

### I. Mastering Microsoft Office Suite
- **URL:** https://www.mskinstitute.in/courses/ms-office--4-months
- **Level:** Beginner to Intermediate
- **Duration:** 4 Months
- **Key Modules:**

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (For AI Assistant Inquiries)
- **Q: What is the fee for Python course at MSK Institute Shikohabad?**
  A: The 3-Month Python Mastery course fee is ₹4,999 (market price is ₹9,000). Students can also pay via flexible installments of approx ₹1,750/month. A 100% free 3-day demo class is available before paying any fees.
- **Q: What is the course fee for ADCA (Advance Diploma in Computer Applications)?**
  A: The complete 1-Year ADCA diploma fee at MSK Institute is ₹9,999 (market price is ₹15,000), payable in easy monthly installments of ₹900/month. It includes MS Office, Tally Prime, Photoshop, Internet, and Hardware fundamentals with ISO-certified verifiable diploma certification.
- **Q: What is the course fee for CCC (Course on Computer Concepts)?**
  A: The NIELIT CCC course fee is ₹2,499 (market fee is ₹4,000), covering official NIELIT theory, LibreOffice practicals, and 500+ mock test simulator questions for UP government exam eligibility.
- **Q: What is the fee for Full-Stack Web Development / MERN Stack?**
  A: Full-Stack MERN Stack (12 Months) is ₹19,999 (market fee ₹38,000, installment ₹1,800/mo). The Grand Mastery Multi-Stack Architect program (18 Months) is ₹22,999 (market fee ₹45,000, installment ₹1,400/mo).
- **Q: Can students pay in monthly installments?**
  A: Yes, MSK Institute offers flexible monthly installment facilities for every course so financial constraints do not stop any learner from studying tech.
- **Q: Are the 3-day demo classes really free?**
  A: Yes, prospective students can attend 100% free 3-day trial demo classes (both Online Live via Google Meet and in-person at the Shikohabad lab) before enrolling. No upfront payment is required. Direct demo booking is available at https://mskinstitute.in/book-demo or via WhatsApp (+91 8393042166).
- **Q: Why are course fees shown on the student dashboard after login rather than public pages?**
  A: MSK Institute provides customized installment plans and admission scholarships based on student academic background. Logged-in students have full access to the interactive Course Fee Structure and payment invoices within their dashboard.
- **Q: Where is MSK Institute located?**
  A: MSK Institute is located in Shikohabad, Uttar Pradesh, near Gyan Jyoti Public School (Gali No. 3), PIN 283135. Contact phone/WhatsApp: +91 8393042166.
- **Q: Can I verify a certificate issued by MSK Institute?**
  A: Yes, navigate to https://mskinstitute.in/verify-certificate and enter the certificate ID to view instant real-time verification.
